author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: Radxa has recently published additional hardware details for the C201, a 120 × 120mm carrier board designed for its compute module based on Qualcomm’s Dragonwing IQ-9075 platform. The board provides access to the module’s high-speed interfaces through dual 2.5GbE, NVMe storage, camera support, as well as RS-232, RS-485, and CAN bus connectivity. The C201 is […]
title: Radxa C201 exposes dual 2.5GbE, NVMe and serial I/O for VMARC-Q9075
